question: The Rajput ruler who maintained cordial relations with Akbar was:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raja Man Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Raja Man Singh** was one of Akbar’s most trusted allies and generals in the Mughal court.
 
• He belonged to the Kachhwaha dynasty of Amber and was related to Akbar by marriage ties, as Akbar married a Rajput princess from the Kachhwaha clan.
 
• Raja Man Singh was appointed as **one of the Navaratnas** (nine gems) in Akbar’s court due to his loyalty and administrative capabilities.
 
• He played a significant role in Akbar’s military campaigns, including those in Bengal, Bihar, and Orissa, which helped consolidate Mughal power in these regions.
